newsitem.title: USA: Many H-P printer cartridges defective - WSJ. [CORRECTED]
newsitem.headline: Many H-P printer cartridges defective - WSJ. [CORRECTED]

text.p: Hewlett-Packard Co said millions of ink-jet printer cartridges shipped earlier this year are defective, the Wall Street Journal reported Thursday.
A piece of tape covering an air hole leaves residue clogging the cartridge, the article said.
The company knew of the defects shortly after they were manufactured in April and May, but did not disclose the problems because it was taking a "wait-and-see attitude", the Journal said.
The cartridges have no serial numbers, so they are difficult to track, but they fit DeskJet 300, 500 and 600 models.

The company said either retailers or Hewlett-Packard will accept returns, and that the problems should not materially affect its financial results, according to the article. (Corrects to show problems should not materially affect results.)
